author: CNN
description:
US President Donald Trump pushed back on Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu this morning ahead of a consequential meeting with his Israeli counterpart, underscoring a strain in the relationship as he downplayed pressure to escalate the war with Iran. Trump was asked during an interview on Fox News’ “Fox & Friends” about reports of Netanyahu’s plans to share intelligence regarding Iran rebuilding its nuclear program.

“I don’t need Bibi to tell me that. Bibi is telling me that because he wants me to stay involved,” Trump said. Later that same day, both met in a conversation described as “one of the best conversations” the two leaders have had, according to Netanyahu.

CNN’s Jake Tapper talks to Tom Nides, a former US Ambassador to Israel on today’s meeting and the war at large.

title: Trump: Netanyahu ‘wants me to stay involved’ in Iran

description: Colt Gray, the Georgia teen who fatally shot two teachers and two students and wounded nine others at Apalachee High School in September 2024, was sentenced Tuesday to life in prison without the possibility of parole. The decision concludes a three-day sentencing hearing that has featured Gray’s guilty plea to 55 charges, emotional victim impact statements, his confessions to police and insights into his motive and mental health.
title: Georgia school shooter sentenced to life in prison without parole

author: CNN
description:
Hundreds of thousands of people in France and Spain have been evacuated from their homes, and wildfires have spread farther than they do on average in an entire year.

Firefighters are battling wildfires close to the cities of Bordeaux and Madrid. France says the fires are far from over and could burn for months, while Spanish authorities say more than 100,000 square miles of land in Madrid have been affected, as exhausted evacuees await a return home.

The wildfires raging in France are so intense they have created “fire clouds,” a never-before-seen phenomenon in the country, authorities say. Temperatures will climb to above-average highs across fire-ravaged areas of France and Spain over the next week, with no signs of rainfall in sight.

title: Europe’s wildfires are so intense, they’re creating 'fire clouds'

President Donald Trump will meet with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu today to discuss the war in Iran, progress on negotiations with Lebanon and efforts to expand the Abraham Accords, according to a White House official.

The leaders' relationship has markedly shifted since the two last met five months ago. The close cooperation and effusive praise from the start of the Iran war have given way to Trump’s expletive-laden outbursts directed at his most vocal international advocate.

description:
Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelensky warns Russia wants Kim Jong Un to send another 30,000 North Korean troops to fight on the frontline.  

South Korean and Western officials estimate more than 10,000 North Korean troops have previously been deployed to Russia’s Kursk region, with thousands killed or wounded.

Trump’s order would give the US Postal Service and the Department of Homeland Security new roles in screening state voter rolls for potential non-citizen voters.
